title: Institute closed for Gandhi Jayanti
text: All batches resume on Friday, 3 October at regular timings.

title: New batch: Professional Diploma in Multimedia
text: Sem-I Graphic Designing starts 12 October. 20 seats; registration closes 5 October.

title: CCC practical assessment
text: Course on Computer Concepts assessment in Lab 2. Bring your admit card.

title: Student showreel & print display
text: Multimedia and DTP students present their final work. Families welcome, 5 PM, main hall.

title: Dussehra holidays
text: The institute stays closed on 20 and 21 October. Sunday batches are unaffected.

title: GST module updated in DCA — Accounting
text: Tally Prime with GST now covers the revised GSTR-3B format. Existing students get the new material free.

title: Diwali break schedule
text: Institute closed 8–12 November. Doubt-clearing resumes 13 November.
